subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming stay as Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and Custom Theme Studio with broader persistence?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower importer model, while this issue asks for a larger built-in authoring and persistence surface that affects product design rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define a narrow theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only
options.body: Document that OpenClaw will delegate theme authoring to tweakcn and keep only the one browser-local import slot, then close this direction as out of scope.

options.title: Split staged issues
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing separately if maintainers want staged delivery.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned to this issue and authored the current custom-theme import path that any broader model would extend or replace.
